name: prometheus_query
description: Query Prometheus/Mimir metrics APIs for instant queries, range queries, series discovery, label exploration, and metadata retrieval with multi-tenant support.
usage_guidance: Use this tool for all Prometheus and Mimir metric queries. Supports instant queries (point-in-time health checks), range queries (time-series analysis), series/label discovery, and metadata lookup. Always specify tenant_id for multi-tenant Mimir deployments. For range queries, the tool auto-selects step size based on time range if not specified. Queries returning >1M estimated data points require human confirmation.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.description: PromQL expression to evaluate. Required for instant_query, range_query.

parameters.name: --time
parameters.description: Evaluation timestamp for instant_query (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp). Defaults to current server time.

parameters.name: --start
parameters.description: Start timestamp for range_query and time-bounded operations (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp). Required for range_query.

parameters.name: --end
parameters.description: End timestamp for range_query and time-bounded operations (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp). Required for range_query.

parameters.name: --step
parameters.description: Query resolution step for range_query (e.g., 15s, 1m, 5m). Auto-selected based on time range if omitted: 15s for <1h, 1m for <6h, 5m for <24h, 1h for >24h.

parameters.name: --match
parameters.description: Series selector for list_series and label operations. Supports PromQL label matchers (e.g., '{job=

parameters.name: --label_name
parameters.description: Label name for label_values action. Required for label_values.

parameters.name: --metric_name
parameters.description: Metric name for metadata action. If omitted, returns metadata for all metrics.

parameters.name: --tenant_id
parameters.description: Mimir tenant ID sent via X-Scope-OrgID header. Required for multi-tenant deployments. Use pipe-delimited IDs for cross-tenant queries (e.g., 'tenant-a|tenant-b').

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of returned series. 0 means disabled (no limit).

parameters.name: --timeout
parameters.description: Query evaluation timeout (e.g., 30s, 2m). Defaults to server-configured timeout.

parameters.name: --endpoint
parameters.description: Prometheus/Mimir API base URL. Defaults to PROMETHEUS_URL environment variable.

parameters.name: --stats
parameters.description: Include query execution statistics in the response.

returns: JSON object with status, data (resultType + result array for queries; label/series arrays for discovery), warnings array, and optional stats. For errors: errorType and error message fields.
